proposed_fields.description: Live go-to-market/marketing requisitions with published date and a still-listed flag verified against the ATS on the research date.
proposed_fields.hypothesis: This is the single highest-signal ABM buying indicator and the catalog has no home for it: account.hiring_velocity_eng covers ENGINEERING only. An open GTM req names the seat the client's product substitutes for, carries a salary band that is the price anchor, and its AGE is the intent signal (a 105-day-open ABM req means they cannot hire it). Without this field every Clue P1 signal has to be smuggled into account.operational_pain as prose.
proposed_fields.example_evidence_span: Ashby posting API: title="Sr Technical Marketing Manager" department="Marketing" publishedAt="2026-06-17T14:11:11.933+00:00" isListed=true

proposed_fields.description: Legal registered entity name (not present in catalog; proposed for captures when available).
proposed_fields.hypothesis: An ABM platform benefits from the legal entity name to ensure contracts, procurement, and POs route to the correct legal organization and to match third-party data sources reliably.
proposed_fields.example_evidence_span: Legal name: Zafran Security, Inc. (registered in Delaware)

proposed_fields.description: Exact Annual Recurring Revenue (company-reported) when available; many sources only report growth claims or third-party estimates.
proposed_fields.hypothesis: Exact ARR is critical to prioritize ABM investment tiers and tailor value propositions; knowing true recurring revenue allows sales to size deals and select appropriate offers.
proposed_fields.example_evidence_span: Zafran reports $20,000,000 ARR as of Q2 2026.

proposed_fields.description: List of named customer logos cited by the company or press (useful for social proof).
proposed_fields.hypothesis: Named customer references help ABM messaging and proof points for target sectors; they enable tailored case studies, references, and peer benchmarking in outreach.

proposed_fields.description: Signal describing open/hiring ABM and marketing roles and their hiring age (vacancy signal for buying intent).
proposed_fields.hypothesis: Open senior ABM/marketing roles (especially long-open) indicate active investment in demand motion and can signal near-term buying intent for ABM tooling and services.
